features.description: MoodWatch continuously analyzes employees' facial expressions from webcam feeds and their typing patterns to infer emotions such as stress, frustration, and engagement in the workplace, aggregating results into dashboards visible to management. Participation is a condition of employment. It is not a medical device and is not deployed for safety reasons; its stated purpose is productivity and wellbeing monitoring.
purposes: infer employee emotional state from webcam and typing data
report team mood trends to management

answer.message: This system falls under an Article 5 prohibited AI practice. Prohibited systems receive no engineering requirements: placing on the market, putting into service, and use are banned, so no requirement backlog can make the system permissible. Seek legal review.
